about: The radar (Dom 2026-10-28, playing live: with free look the hero turns away from threats, so a small mini-map): a dark translucent disc in a HUD corner, the hero at its centre, rotated with the camera so UP is where the camera looks. One small dot per thing: hostile bosses and NPCs red, other players blue, friendly NPCs yellow, a boss waiting to respawn a dim dot (or none: classes.dead.show false). A dot beyond rangeMetres is held on the rim at its bearing, so a threat behind the hero still shows. No text; the only animation is the kill flash below. PRESENTATION ONLY (src/fight/radar.ts): it reads the zone's spawn rows and live boss positions, the hero and the view yaw; it never touches the sim, the camera or the input, and it is pointer-events none (the right-thumb look zone is not eaten). Remote players come from the presence handle (?presence=, off by default); with none the radar shows bosses only. on:false or ?radar=off hides it (default on). corner: top-left | top-right | bottom-left | bottom-right, marginPx from the screen edge plus the safe area; offsetPx pushes it further along the vertical edge (clear of a bar). sizePx is the disc diameter; rimInset is how far in from the edge (as a fraction of the radius) a clamped dot sits. kinds: a zone spawn's kind -> its class (hostile | npc); defaultKind is the class of a kind not listed. classes: dot colour (#rrggbb), alpha and size in px per class; edgeAlpha multiplies a dot held on the rim. hero: the centre mark (a small chevron pointing up). flash (Dom 2026-10-28): after the hero kills a boss the live red dots pulse yellow (the dot stays red and swells by dotGrow; a thin yellow halo, haloPx wide, spreads ringPx out from it and fades; yellow never covers the red) for pulseSeconds every periodSeconds, so the eye finds where to go next; it starts at the kill and stops when the next fight begins; a dot within stopWithinMetres of the hero does not pulse; the dim dead dots never pulse; on:false turns it off. Session only, not saved.
